disclosures: Wheeled rover (raycast-vehicle class): Rigid-body raycast vehicle, Coulomb friction, no soil mechanics. Verdicts valid for this model class only.
Quadruped (kinematic capability envelope): Kinematic capability envelope anchored to ANYmal published spec (footprint, max step, max slope). No gait simulation performed or implied.
Probe methodology: seeded probe rain with CCD; every fall-through cross-checked by an independent raycast at the probe's exit point before it counts as a hole.
Trust states cover robot-REACHABLE space only; 'observed' means no physical experiment touched the cell.
Detection floor: at this coverage (ray grid 0.1 m, ~0.26 m probe spacing over 30 m²), 'verified' rules out collider holes with footprint ≥ ~0.26 m; smaller defects are below the instrument's floor.

Divergence 'lying' threshold self-calibrated to this world's simplification noise floor: 0.433 m (1.5x the p99 splat-to-collider distance on probe-verified cells). 'Lying' means divergence beyond the vendor's own demonstrated simplification tolerance.
Single-level survey: one walkable surface per column; multi-level worlds are unsupported in this version.
Scope of the grade: it predicts navmesh-level traversability under the disclosed model class. It does not predict policy transfer or visual-domain fidelity.
All measurements carry uncertainty ranges; the methods line under each number states how it was obtained.
